meta.author:
約書亞樂團
詞曲：周巽光、璽恩、許書珩、鄭牧德
中譯英：王建玫

lines.a: 我帶著忐忑的心 在這最後宴席
lines.b: I come with a trembling heart to the final supper

lines.a: 貼近桌前沈默的祢
lines.b: Drawing close to You, my silent Lord

lines.a: 祢突然向我靠近 俯身為我屈膝
lines.b: Suddenly You draw so near, bending down on Your knees

lines.a: 將我的雙腳都洗淨
lines.b: Washing every stain from both my feet

lines.a: 祢謙卑 代替了所有不配
lines.b: Humble King, taking all my worthlessness Bow down,

lines.a: 降服 使我們 在愛中緊緊跟隨
lines.b: Lord we will, follow closely in Your love

lines.a: 祢竟為我 破碎祢的身體
lines.b: Just for my sake, broken in love for me

lines.a: 讓我能與祢 共享復活生命
lines.b: So that I can now share in eternity

lines.a: 祢的寶血 湧流奇妙恩典
lines.b: Your precious blood, flows with a wondrous grace

lines.a: 除去羞愧 為我洗淨 所有罪
lines.b: Wash away shame, making me clean from all sin

lines.a: 我帶著敬畏的心 與祢一同坐席
lines.b: I come with a rev'rent heart ,sitting down here with You

lines.a: 等候領受聽祢聲音
lines.b: Waiting to receive and hear Your voice

lines.a: 十架上 祢替代我的虧欠
lines.b: On the cross, You have paid for all my debts

lines.a: 祢餅 祢的杯 是我救贖恩典
lines.b: Your bread, and Your cup, are my sweet saving grace

lines.a: 祢所立的新約 宣告恩典禧年
lines.b: Covenant that You made, sounds the great jubilee

lines.a: 我不再被控告和定罪
lines.b: I am no longer condemned or shamed

lines.a: 基督在我裡面 這是我信心宣言
lines.b: Christ is living in me, this is my declaration

lines.a: 祢的身體 甘心為我破碎
lines.b: Lord, Your body, gladly broken for me

lines.a: 我何等感謝 祢愛將我贖回
lines.b: Oh, how I thank You, Your love has ransomed me

lines.a: 祢的寶血 甘心為我預備
lines.b: Your precious blood, gladly poured out for me

lines.a: 使我坦然無懼來到 祢面前
lines.b: So I can come without a fear to Your throne
